content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

General rule: aim for 0.7–1g of protein per pound of bodyweight (or about 1.6–2.2g per kg) daily. That covers muscle growth when you're training hard and eating enough total calories. Spread it across meals—your body can only use so much per sitting, so consistency matters more than mega-doses.

Your goal is 100kg bench in three months, so fuel it right: prioritize protein, hit your calories, and train heavy. Are you tracking your nutrition right now, or want to dial it in?
